# ADR 0004: Bulk runs on virtual threads with batched writes

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Credit-card default risk scorecard API

## Context

Re-scoring 30,000 customers should take seconds and not overload the database.

## Decision

Partition customers into chunks processed on virtual threads; write scores with JDBC batches; bound concurrency with a semaphore.

## Consequences

Fast and resource-bounded; progress is observable.

## Alternatives considered

Single-threaded loop (slow); parallel streams (shared pool).
